effects: startup calls setup for both families, catches Core Exception into StartupLoader, applies SOCKS settings when selected, and registers inbound/proxy setting callbacks. Incoming callbacks recompute affected v4/v6 setup and report caught errors; proxy updates call Socket::socksUpdated and report SocketException.

get(bool/int/string) reads autoSettings variant only while either autodetect setting is enabled and that key exists, else falls back to SettingsManager. set(str) stores in autoSettings under autodetect or writes SettingsManager otherwise. editAutoSettings disables v4 AUTO_DETECT_CONNECTION, writes cached string/int overrides (not bool overrides), clears cache and fires SettingChanged.

detectConnection no-ops while either family is running; starts only enabled/non-disabled families and emits Started. It closes current relevant mapper, disconnects, restores family defaults, then listens. Listen failure sets both incoming modes passive, logs and emits Finished(false,true) and Finished(true,true); success classifies public v4 as ACTIVE, private v4 as ACTIVE_UPNP; public v6 as ACTIVE and non-public v6 as DISABLED; private v4 attempts mapping.

setup closes mapper when family settings changed or autodetected family is disabled; clears no-longer-used auto settings; reruns detection when needed; otherwise resets listening sockets after changes. Explicit ACTIVE_UPNP modes start mappers when not already running. close closes mapper workers; disconnect tears down search and transfer listeners.

getStatus returns family status; getMappers delegates to MappingManager. getInformation reports detection status/mode, external IPs, bind addresses and ports; while running it returns a fixed configuration-in-progress message. isActive is true for active incoming modes or any favorite active hub. Typed status log emits Message(LogMessagePtr); normal logs only call LogManager.

clearAutoSettings erases family external-IP, bind-address, no-IP-override and incoming-mode overrides; resetDefaults stores SettingsManager defaults. When either configured family remains enabled/non-disabled with autodetection off, configured TCP/UDP/TLS ports are preferred; resetDefaults otherwise seeds default port values.

effects: Registers MiniUPnP for both families; NAT-PMP (HAVE_NATPMP_H) and Windows UPnP (WIN32) only for IPv4. open returns false if already open, no providers, or busy; otherwise starts worker.

Worker tries preferred MAPPER first, then others; initializes with explicit bind address or empty default, creates TCP transfer, TCP secure-transfer and UDP search rules for non-empty ports, closes partial mappings and advances on failure. Success takes unique ownership of provider; external IP updates only when family NO_IP_OVERRIDE allows, then mappingFinished and renewal are scheduled.

Renewal is at max(provider interval, 10 minutes); renewal reinitializes provider and retries existing rules, intentionally ignores per-rule failures, then reschedules. close joins worker, removes renewal listener, reinitializes/removes active rules and clears provider. If all providers fail, mappingFinished receives empty name.
errors: open returns false for already-open/no-provider/busy cases; starting the Thread may throw ThreadException. Provider init/add failures log and fall through; no provider success reports empty mapper to ConnectivityManager. Renewal start catches ThreadException and clears busy for later retry.
